items.author: kirsties.wsocial.eu
items.context: You know, I didn't think I was a gamer but from the ZX Spectrum onward I have always played games! 😄 Funny how we choose to see ourselves sometimes isn't it? Currently absolutely obsessed with cosy game Stardew Valley as it's about all I can cope with cognitively and I adore the gameplay #wgames
items.text: Stardew is a lovely fit for that: no one rushes you, and every day is a small, finishable chunk you can do at your own pace. Glad you found a game that feels this good.

items.author: reichurin.bsky.social
items.context: tbh stardew is perfect for it but my laptop runs hot when i open even a single tab so im put off from playing games on it. i have mistria too, maybe i should give it another go? last played it in beta where i just knew too little so it felt like there was nothing to do almost?
items.text: Stardew is a pixel game that runs on very modest hardware, so it's usually much easier on a hot laptop than newer 3D games. A hard surface or a cooling pad under the laptop helps too.
